external_split_and_protected_supervision.fail_closed_rule: If trial identity, allowed telemetry, or pointer recovery requires successful, failed, anomalous, split, frame-annotation, or hidden outcome information, the source must be rejected or downgraded rather than filtered post hoc.

candidate_claim_ir_fit.trusted_modality_requirement: Observed, reported, derived, and hypothesized status must be supplied by trusted source metadata and guards. The LLM may not infer a task anomaly, failure, success, or causal explanation and promote it to observed evidence.
candidate_claim_ir_fit.candidate_q_boundary: Any interpretation of placement progress, anomaly, failure, collision, or causal state may only be a candidate q or conditional hypothesis and may not be trained from protected annotations under this source role.

A future review must demonstrate an evidence-safe semantic normalization or candidate-q increment beyond deterministic parsing. Visual anomaly detection or outcome prediction is outside the current Candidate Claim IR role.

evidence: The immutable record contains one inspected release and three archives totaling 8137837222 bytes, each with an MD5 checksum.
Zenodo and DataCite consistently identify record-scope CC-BY-4.0 rights.
The curator explicitly names 121 placement trials, including 48 train-successful, 6 validation-successful, 60 test-anomalous, and 7 test-successful trials.
The curator explicitly declares multimodal visual, force-torque, joint, calibration, and frame-level annotation surfaces.
No top-level outcome-blind trial manifest, non-visual telemetry object, or annotation-free object is published.
The possible paper and repository are not explicitly bound to the Zenodo record and provide no trial manifest or archive-key mapping.
inference: Immutable identity, consistent record rights, and the curator-declared source-native trial count are sufficient to retain the family as a metadata candidate.
Outcome-stratified external archives and frame-level annotations are protected supervision risks, not Project05 roles or labels.
No source role, lineage, sample, quota, or pointer credit is available before outcome-blind manifest, privacy, notice, member, and source-round-trip audits.
The smallest validation archive is a future bounded audit candidate only because it has six declared trials and the smallest immutable byte surface; it is not Project05 validation data.
The family must be rejected or downgraded if safe non-visual telemetry cannot be physically isolated or if trial identity depends on split or outcome.
Even a technically safe surface must show a measurable LLM semantic-editor increment over Rule/Reuse and a defensible executed-evidence role.
recommendation: Do not write the effective catalog, assign a role, award credit, download or open an archive, or generate samples under this review.
If separately authorized, first freeze an exact bounded acquisition contract for only place_action_validation.tar.gz.
Do not inherit the external validation name or successful-only composition as a Project05 role, label, target, split, or safety claim.

Before any archive open, freeze reader identity, member and byte caps, nested notice, privacy, visual exclusion, outcome and annotation exclusion, outcome-blind trial manifest, lineage, and pointer rules.
